name: Asana
description: Asana is a work management platform that provides a REST API (and official MCP server) for reading and writing its 'Work Graph' — tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, teams, and workflow automation.
gating_notes: Free Asana signup gives immediate access to the developer console (app.asana.com/0/my-apps) to generate a Personal Access Token or register an OAuth app — no paid plan or approval needed for PAT/OAuth. Only 'Service Accounts' (full org-wide data access) require an Enterprise tier and provisioning by a super admin. The official MCP server is available on all plan tiers via OAuth login, though Enterprise+/Legacy Enterprise admins can optionally block/allow specific MCP clients org-wide.
mcp_notes: Asana operates an official, generally-available MCP server (v2) at mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp using Streamable HTTP transport and OAuth, covering tasks, subtasks, dependencies, comments, projects, status updates, goals, portfolios, teams, users, and workspaces. Documented at developers.asana.com/docs/mcp-server and developers.asana.com/docs/using-asanas-mcp-server. Community servers (e.g. roychri/mcp-server-asana) also exist.
